summary: Adopt current Wellmanifest governance and terminal receipt policy

delivery.outcome: FixOS adopts the current published Wellmanifest/new-project governance package, tracks its host contract and Policy DSL dependency, binds Python packaging to the gate, and aligns terminal publication with protected external merge receipts.
nonGoals: No change to FixOS runtime behavior, dependencies or application tests.
No ticket closure commit or carrier-only closure PR.
No secret access, GitHub merge or external provider mutation outside the protected publication path.

architecture.decision: Use Goal governance adoption against the immutable published Wellmanifest/new-project revision; make only the standard-required ignore exceptions before installing managed artifacts, bind the existing Python package lifecycle to the gate, and keep all application paths outside scope.
architecture.rollback: Revert the adoption commit and restore the previous pinned governance package after preserving the adoption receipt.

validation.evidence: Preflight is clean and the adopted host contract validates the tracked host files and package lifecycle.
Goal installed the immutable 0.20.31 package; policy DSL files and packaging metadata are included in the material adoption change.
Pending exact-head publication after local stack, governance and application checks.
